Pumpkin Cozy — Fall Cup Sleeve 🎃

A beige cup sleeve with a little puffy pumpkin and a cinnamon stick — quick, cozy, and made to fit your favorite to-go cup.

Hey, it's Sara. I made this one on a chilly morning with the window open and it took me about an hour and a half. I wanted a cozy that actually fits — not too tight, not sliding off — so I measured it on a real cup with a tape measure as I went. This is the long beginner version with photos for each step.

Level Beginner — single crochet in the round + small pumpkin — about 1.5 hours
Yarn Worsted cotton — Beige 40g, Orange 15g, Brown 5g — 5.0mm for cozy, 4.5mm for pumpkin — plus 2in cinnamon stick
Size Cozy 4in tall × fits 12-16oz cup — 32 sc around — Pumpkin 1.75in wide ×1.25in tall — Gauge: 16 sc =4in, 18 rows =4in

In this tutorial

  • What you need
  • Gauge — measured with tape
  • The cozy — 32 sc ×16 rounds
  • The little pumpkin

What you need

MATERIALS:
Beige worsted cotton — 40g — I used about 0.8 of a 50g skein — Lily Sugar'n Cream Beige or any worsted cotton
Orange worsted — 15g for pumpkin — about 1/3 skein
Brown worsted — 5g for stem
Hook: 5.0mm for cozy, 4.5mm for pumpkin
Notions: tapestry needle, scissors, stitch marker, small pinch of polyfill, one 2in cinnamon stick
Cup: standard 12-16oz to-go cup — about 10in around where the cozy sits

Gauge — measured with tape

GAUGE — 5.0mm hook, single crochet in the round:
16 sc =4in wide — 4 stitches per inch
18 rows =4in tall — about 4.5 rows per inch
I measured this flat after blocking lightly. If your swatch is tighter (18 sc =4in) go up to 5.5mm. If looser (14 sc =4in) go down to 4.5mm.

The cozy — 32 sc ×16 rounds

Make 1

32 stitches around, 16 rounds tall — I measured 4in tall with a tape measure
COZY — Beige, 5.0mm — worked in joined rounds:
Ch 32, slip stitch to first chain to make a ring — make sure it isn't twisted
R1: ch1, sc 32 around, sl st to first sc — 32 sc
R2-R14: ch1, sc 32 around, sl st — 13 rounds — this is the main body
R15: ch1, sc 32 around, sl st
R16: ch1, sc 32 around, sl st — final round
Border: sl st 32 around once for a neat edge
Fasten off and weave ends inside.

Total: 16 rounds of sc. On my tape measure it came out just under 4in tall — about 3.9in to 4in depending on how you block it.
Beginner tip: Put a marker at the start of each round and count 32 every round. It needs to stay 32 — if you have 33 you added one, if 31 you missed one. Fix it now and the cozy will stretch evenly.

The little pumpkin

Make 1

Magic ring, build body, add ridges and stuff, add brown stem — 1.75in wide ×1.25in tall
PUMPKIN — Orange, 4.5mm:
R1: Magic ring 6 sc — 6
R2: inc around — 12
R3: [sc, inc] 6 times — 18
R4: [2 sc, inc] 6 times — 24 — widest point
R5-R8: sc 24 around for 4 rounds — straight sides
R9: [2 sc, dec] 6 times — 18 — start closing
R10: [sc, dec] 6 times — 12 — add a small pinch of polyfill now — about a walnut-sized amount
R11: dec 6 times — 6 — close, leave a long tail

RIDGES — with long tail:
Thread needle, go from top center to bottom center, wrap around outside back to top, pull gently to make a ridge. Repeat 6 times evenly spaced. This makes 6 little sections.

STEM — Brown, 4.5mm:
Chain 4, sc in 2nd chain and next 2 chains — 3 sc — sew to top center of pumpkin.

Putting it together

ASSEMBLY:
1. Cozy: 32 sc around, 16 rounds tall — about 4in tall
2. Pumpkin: 1.75in wide ×1.25in tall — 6 ridges
3. Pin pumpkin to cozy — centered, about 1in up from bottom edge
4. Sew pumpkin base to cozy with 12 small whip stitches around — go through cozy twice so it holds
5. Tuck cinnamon stick behind stem at an angle — sew with 2 stitches of brown yarn or a dot of hot glue

Measurements on a real cup — honest numbers

HOW IT FITS — MEASURED ON MY CUP:
My cozy measures 8in around flat (doubled flat width 4in). On a cup it stretches to about 10in around.
A 10in circle is about 3.18in diameter in math (10 ÷ 3.1416), but to-go cups taper — wider at the top than the bottom — and crochet stretches a little. On my 16oz cup, the cozy sits at about 3.25in to 3.5in diameter at the bottom edge and a little looser near the top, so it grips without sliding. The 3.75in you see in some photos is with the cozy pulled up a bit higher where the cup is wider — it varies by cup brand.

Cozy height: 16 rounds measured 3.9in to 4in on my tape — I list it as 4in tall.
Pumpkin: measured with calipers — 1.75in wide ×1.25in tall after ridges and light stuffing.

Yarn used — weighed on my kitchen scale after finishing:
Beige cozy: 40g
Orange pumpkin body: 15g
Brown stem: 5g
Total 60g yarn plus a pinch of filling. I list 40g/15g/5g because that's what my scale said — your tension might use a few grams more or less, so grab an extra 10g buffer if you crochet tightly.

Final

Final — cozy about 4in tall, pumpkin 1.75in wide, fits 12-16oz cup — Fall 2026
